semiconductor_relevance: None — CoreTech System (Moldex3D) primarily focuses on plastic injection molding simulation, which is not directly relevant to semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: CoreTech System (Moldex3D) Co., Ltd. specializes in providing computer-aided engineering software for the plastic injection molding industry. Their Moldex3D software offers advanced simulation capabilities to optimize product designs and manufacturability, particularly in the context of plastic components.
capabilities: Advanced simulation for injection molding processes
Optimization of product designs and manufacturability
